```{r}
library(tinytable)

variable_descriptions <- data.frame(Variable = c("Disease", "Disease Category", "January-December", "Yearly Cases", "Yearly Counts", "Year"), 
                                    Decription = c(
                                                    "Name of reported disease.", 
                                                    "The reporting catgeory assigned to the disease, as distinguished by Toronto Public Health.", 
                                                    "Reported case counts for the months of the calender year.", 
                                                    "Reporetd case counts for the year of surveillence for a given disease.", 
                                                    "Rate of cases expressed as cases per 100'000 population for year.", 
                                                    "Year of observation."

                                                        )
                                                        )
tt(variable_descriptions)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-disease-catgeories
#| tbl-cap: "Diseases included in each category, 2021–2025."
#| echo: false

# Mark diseases that do not have an entry in all five study years.
diseases_by_category <- disease_data |>
  filter(Year %in% 2021:2025) |>
  group_by(`Disease Category`, Disease) |>
  summarise(Years = n_distinct(Year), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(Disease = if_else(Years < 5, paste0(Disease, "*"), Disease)) |>
  arrange(`Disease Category`, Disease) |>
  group_by(`Disease Category`) |>
  summarise(Diseases = paste(Disease, collapse = "; "), .groups = "drop")

tt(
  diseases_by_category,
  width = c(0.25, 0.75),
  notes = "* Not listed in every year from 2021 to 2025. Zero-case entries count as listed; an entry does not imply complete monthly reporting."
)
```
